protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: In v2.1.6 an authenticated note form POSTs the unsanitized comment to admin.activities.store; ActivityRepository persists request data, ActivityResource returns comment unchanged, and the Persons/Leads activity component renders activity.comment through v-safe-html, whose directive assigns DOMPurify.sanitize(binding.value) to innerHTML. Issue #2419 documents persistent cross-user unsafe HTML/CSS/JS rendering on v2.1.6, and the maintainer treated it as security and verified the later escaping fix. CVE-2026-5370 is PUBLISHED and GHSA-9m2v-hc5g-5jpv is not withdrawn, although their composeMail/73ed28d pointers are incorrect.
